folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B141, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full format comparison and OD13 continuation were reviewed. The one-realm/one-prestige delivery constraint and 1366x768 proposal are historical, superseded by the later scope and viewport direction. O2 and A1 remain hypotheses, not a mandatory scene-first prototype, required portrait policy or new engine. Current [DESIGN](../DESIGN.md) selects functional task composition and prose-first reading while permitting a deliberately useful map, diagram or expressive moment. Strong means can bypass spatial obstacles rather than being disabled to protect a view (AD32, AD38, AD40).

OD13's narration direction is distinct from the older format recommendations. Preserve NR1-NR5: different speakers and records may know different things, an actual truth-reading means can be exact within scope, and discovering one false statement does not certify all other claims. Optional unreliability does not make save failures, comfort settings or action commitments unreliable by default. A talking cheat's personality is not proof of omniscience, obedience or control. Source inspiration remains separately qualified; no linked source, scene renderer or real journey was newly verified by reading this assessment.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B141, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All MW rules, protocol, historical study details and later native-character correction were reviewed. Use the last applicable native route: recipe and launch are archived, the old character view is a sketch, native-character has one live instance with layout switching, and its simultaneous interactive compare is disabled. The gallery is matched screenshot evidence, not command mirroring. MW6 permits the isolated native startup documented later; it does not permit personal saves or production storage.

Preserve MW8's two axes. A fresh input hash cannot prove a complete dependency manifest or a faithful populated task, and a frozen old capture can remain useful history while being stale. A native rebuild proves identity, then affected keyboard, action, return and persistence journeys need their scoped evidence. The 15-second banner detects declared drift while open; it is neither automatic rebuilding nor an unattended monitor. No command replay should occur when applying a fixture snapshot; selection, inspection and geometry changes stay distinct from gameplay examination. Exported review JSON is synthetic review material, not an importable game save or an approved UI selection (AD32, AD36, AD42). No new study was built or served.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B141, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Parts 1-3 and all AU/CH/PI/F/M/L rows were read. F1's absent USER_VISION entry is superseded by the existing [format/view direction record](../../USER_VISION.md#format-portraits-and-view-decisions-2026-10-14); Q1-Q3 remain proposals, not adopted by this writeup. Current source also qualifies F3: `story_aftermath.js` now derives visitor presence through `generatedPeoplePresenceFacts`, `eligibleAftermath` requires a matching present person and aged known request receipt, and `aftermathPersonPresent` supplies a check. This closes the old source-absence claim at that named seam, not all native integration or behavior proof.

Preserve the useful causal comparison: delivered and declined branches may reach the same later scene while retaining different purse, supply, relationship and receipt facts. A remembered fact is not permission to invent a live utterance from an absent person; actual messages or delayed accounts would need their own channel. The current presence bridge advances a context-frame projection and does not persist a second schedule. Its actual caller frame, offer/commit revalidation, away return and pending-receipt reload remain selected-route checks, not newly verified results.

The old exact traveler count, Village-only history and person-owner boundaries were source snapshots. This pass does not credit a general actor bridge or book-world memory from them, nor require a new identity service for a presentation study. Actual NPC memory can have an owner beyond a single receipt; PI4's receipt-only phrase describes this prototype's event evidence, not every possible memory mechanism. Current desktop direction replaces the old 1366 target, and MW8 governs any new comparison. No prototype, new callback fix or native proof was executed here (AD32, AD36, AD42, AD51).
